author: Athul Prem
scope: Uniform guide at 1 GHz, left incidence. Axial spacing changes at fixed discrete SAFE ports. Thickness subdivision changes both body and SAFE section, so each result uses its own discrete reference. SAFE phase drift is recorded separately. Patterned-device error and continuum accuracy require their own checks.
phase_reference: exp(i*k*L) for the same signed-power propagating root at both ends

axial_200_thickness_1.complex_encoding: [real, imaginary] pairs, outgoing rows and incoming columns
